long_biography.plain_text:
David Hows converted a demanding offshore-sailing practice into Ocean Sailing Expeditions after an earlier career spanning retail management and property services. The New Zealander bought his first keelboat in 2011, crossed the Tasman two years later and gradually made difficult passages available to paying crews.

Hows built the operation around training, safety and participation in ocean passages, regattas and expeditions across Australasia and the South Pacific. He also launched Ocean Sailing Podcast to preserve long-form accounts from racers and cruisers, extending the teaching element beyond each voyage. His own racing continued alongside the business through repeated offshore events, trans-Tasman challenges and advanced Yachtmaster qualifications.

David Hows converted a demanding offshore-sailing practice into Ocean Sailing Expeditions after an earlier career spanning retail management and property services. Hows built the operation around training, safety and participation in ocean passages, regattas and expeditions across Australasia and the South Pacific. He also launched Ocean Sailing Podcast to preserve long-form accounts from racers and cruisers, extending the teaching element beyond each voyage. His own racing continued alongside the business through repeated offshore events, trans-Tasman challenges and advanced Yachtmaster qualifications.
